title: HackerEarth: Little Monk and Toy Story
description: Little Monk has toy boxes with given `weights`. He wants to build a pyramid where each higher tier has strictly fewer boxes and strictly less total weight than the tier below it. Return maximum number of tiers he can build.
constraints:
1 <= len(weights) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(1)
solution:
def max_toy_tiers(weights: list[int]) -> int:
    s = sorted(weights)
    tiers = 0
    prev_count = prev_weight = 0
    curr_count = curr_weight = 0
    for w in s:
        curr_count += 1
        curr_weight += w
        if curr_count > prev_count and curr_weight > prev_weight:
            tiers += 1
            prev_count = curr_count
            prev_weight = curr_weight
            curr_count = curr_weight = 0
    return tiers
explanation: Greedy construction sorting weights and growing tier sizes sequentially in O(N log N) time.
